title: fix: show historical scan data on domain subpages for SKIPPED_UNCHANGED pages
body:
Domain report pages (e.g. `domains/cms-gov/accessibility.html`) were always empty because `DashboardCompiler` only used the current run's `pagesScanned` data. Pages that were `SKIPPED_UNCHANGED` have `liveAudits: null`, and targets that are all-unchanged (or not reached before the runtime budget expires) produce pages with zero findings.

Historical scan data is already fetched at workflow start into `.history-cache/runs/latest.json` by `scripts/fetch-history.mjs` but was never consulted when building domain subpages.

## Changes

- **`loadHistoricalPagesForTarget(targetId)`** — new private static method on `DashboardCompiler`; reads `.history-cache/runs/latest.json` (keyed by `VITAL_HISTORY_CACHE_DIR`) and returns pages with real `liveAudits` for the given target. Returns `[]` safely when the env var is unset.

- **`writeDomainSubpages()`** — after loading the current run's `pages`, now builds `allKnownPages`:
  - Current pages with `liveAudits: null` are back-filled with their historical counterpart
  - Historical pages for URLs absent from the current run entirely are appended
  - A `hasHistoricalData` flag drives a disclosure note in the rendered HTML

- **`allViolations`, `topRuleRows`, `accessibilityRows`** — all switched from `pages` to `allKnownPages`

- **`accessibility.html`** — adds a contextual note when historical data is being shown; updated empty-state copy from "No violations in latest run" to "No violations found across current and recent runs"
